blocks.task_summary: Determine the median m of the continuous random variable X with pdf f(x)=arccos(x) on [0,1] by solving ∫₀ᵐ arccos(x)dx = 0.5.
method_path: Set up median equation ∫₀ᵐ arccos(x) dx = 0.5

evidence.basis: recognises that ∫₀ᵐ arccos x dx = 0.5 (M1); [x arccos x − √(1−x²)]₀ᵐ = 0.5; m = 0.360 A1

blocks.task_summary: Given P(|X − m| ≤ a) = 0.3, set up the definite integral ∫_{m−a}^{m+a} arccos(x) dx = 0.3 and solve numerically for a.
method_path: Translate |X − m| ≤ a to interval m − a ≤ X ≤ m + a
Set up P(m−a ≤ X ≤ m+a) = ∫_{m−a}^{m+a} arccos(x) dx = 0.3
Integrate arccos(x) to obtain expression in m and a
Substitute m ≈ 0.360 and solve numerically for a
accepted_alternatives: METHOD 2: Translate pdf by substituting u = x − m, giving ∫_{−a}^{a} arccos(u + m) du = 0.3, then solve for a.
METHOD 3: Use ∫_{−a}^{a} arccos(x + m) dx = 0.3 or ∫_{m−a}^{m+a} arccos(m − x) dx = 0.3 or equivalent symmetric forms, then solve for a.

evidence.basis: METHOD 1: attempts to find at least one endpoint both in terms of m (or their m) and a (M1); ∫_{m−a}^{m+a} arccos x dx = 0.3 (A1); attempts to solve their equation for a (M1) dependent on first M1; a = 0.125 A1
METHOD 2: ∫_{−a}^{a} arccos(x − 0.360034…) dx = 0.3 (M1)(A1); attempts to solve for a (M1); a = 0.125 A1
